title: Nautilus eBook – Proteomics and neuroscience
summary: Learn how researchers advancing the study of the brain and broader nervous system through the power of proteins.
body_markdown:
The latest edition of the Proteomics and neuroscience eBook showcases how researchers are using the Nautilus Voyager™ Platform to develop novel insights into the roles of tau proteoforms in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias.


In this edition of the eBook, you’ll find:


- Brief background on the tau protein and its role in Alzheimer’s disease.
- Examples of how researchers are using the Nautilus Voyager Platform and its underlying Iterative Mapping methodology to study tau proteoforms at the single-molecule level and develop novel insights into their functional roles in Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias.
- How you can be one of the first to incorporate the Nautilus Voyager Platform into your workflows.


[Download the eBook here.](https://nautilus-21430832.hs-sites-na2.com/download-the-proteomics-and-neuroscience-ebook)
